title: docs: make x402 prepaid keys findable by agents
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added an x402 Prepaid Keys guide to the API docs and `/docs/llm.txt?section=x402`, with links from gen and enter’s `llms.txt` and the authentication guide. It explains how an agent can buy a prepaid key without an account using USDC on Base: request an amount from $0.01 to $10,000, sign the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` terms, retry with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`, then use the returned key for generation and check its balance. The `pollinations-api` agent skill now covers this option when no user can approve device sign-in and says to spend only with the user’s permission. Missing-key 401 responses now link to the purchase endpoint. The generated API docs show the public x402 paths on enter without authentication and use `0.50` as the purchase example.
